title: "For visualization"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggrepel)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Load the fully annotated 22-organoid list
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

results_dir <- "./offtarget_results"

annotated_list_path <- file.path(
  results_dir,
  "03_cao_fetal_azimuth",
  "sc_organoid_list_with_fetal_hca_and_cao_labels.rds"
)

if (!file.exists(annotated_list_path)) {
  stop("Annotated organoid list not found: ", annotated_list_path)
}

message("Loading the fully annotated organoid list...")
org_list <- readRDS(annotated_list_path)

if (!is.list(org_list) || length(org_list) != 22L) {
  stop("Expected a list containing exactly 22 organoid datasets")
}

message("Loaded 22 organoid Seurat objects")


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Confirm that all required annotation fields are available
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_metadata <- c(
  ## Final manuscript/adult-HCA annotation
  "celltype",

  ## Fetal-HCA classification
  "fetal_hca_queried",
  "fetal_hca_consensus",
  "fetal_hca_vote_support",
  "fetal_hca_recovered",
  "offtarget_analysis_status",
  "sequential_hca_celltype",
  "sequential_hca_label_source",

  ## Cao fetal multi-organ Azimuth classification
  "cao_fetal_organ",
  "cao_fetal_organ_score"
)

missing_metadata <- lapply(names(org_list), function(dataset) {
  setdiff(required_metadata, colnames(org_list[[dataset]]@meta.data))
})
names(missing_metadata) <- names(org_list)

datasets_with_missing_metadata <- names(missing_metadata)[
  lengths(missing_metadata) > 0L
]

if (length(datasets_with_missing_metadata)) {
  missing_message <- vapply(
    datasets_with_missing_metadata,
    function(dataset) {
      paste0(
        dataset, ": ",
        paste(missing_metadata[[dataset]], collapse = ", ")
      )
    },
    character(1)
  )

  stop(
    "Required annotation fields are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_message, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

message("All adult-HCA, fetal-HCA and Cao metadata fields are present")


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Add standardized visualization aliases
##
## These aliases do not replace the original fields. They make later plotting
## code shorter and reduce the chance of accidentally using the wrong label.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

for (dataset in names(org_list)) {
  object <- org_list[[dataset]]
  metadata <- object@meta.data

  object$analysis_dataset <- dataset
  object$analysis_cell_id <- rownames(metadata)
  object$analysis_cell_key <- paste(
    dataset,
    rownames(metadata),
    sep = "::"
  )

  ## Primary adult-HCA label:
  ## this is the final manuscript consensus
  object$hca_adult_label <- as.character(metadata$celltype)

  ## Only adult-HCA-unassigned cells were queried against fetal HCA.
  object$hca_fetal_label <- ifelse(
    metadata$fetal_hca_queried,
    as.character(metadata$fetal_hca_consensus),
    NA_character_
  )

  object$hca_fetal_status <- as.character(
    metadata$offtarget_analysis_status
  )

  ## Cao was run only on cells unresolved by both adult and fetal HCA.
  object$cao_organ_label <- ifelse(
    metadata$cao_fetal_queried,
    as.character(metadata$cao_fetal_organ),
    NA_character_
  )
  object$cao_organ_score <- ifelse(
    metadata$cao_fetal_queried,
    as.numeric(metadata$cao_fetal_organ_score),
    NA_real_
  )

  org_list[[dataset]] <- object
  rm(object, metadata)
}


message("The fully annotated 22-organoid list is ready as: org_list")

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Apply the organ-only off-target rule and create the four-way status
##
## Off-target definition:
##   - unresolved by both adult and fetal HCA;
##   - Cao predicted organ is non-Heart with prediction score of at least 0.70.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cao_score_threshold <- 0.70
heart_label <- "Heart"



four_way_levels <- c(
  "Adult-heart assigned",
  "Fetal cardiac-compatible",
  "Extra-cardiac assigned",
  "Unresolved"
)

for (dataset in names(org_list)) {
  object <- org_list[[dataset]]
  metadata <- object@meta.data
  number_of_cells <- nrow(metadata)

  adult_assigned <- as.character(metadata$celltype) != "unassigned"

  fetal_recovered <-
    as.character(metadata$celltype) == "unassigned" &
    metadata$fetal_hca_recovered %in% TRUE

  doubly_unassigned <-
    as.character(metadata$offtarget_analysis_status) ==
      "doubly_unassigned"

  cao_decision_fields <- c(
    "cao_fetal_organ",
    "cao_fetal_organ_score"
  )

  organ_only_nonheart_offtarget <- rep(FALSE, number_of_cells)

  if (any(doubly_unassigned)) {
    query_organ <- as.character(
      metadata$cao_fetal_organ[doubly_unassigned]
    )
    query_organ_score <- as.numeric(
      metadata$cao_fetal_organ_score[doubly_unassigned]
    )
    ## Organ-only off-target definition selected for the main analysis.
    organ_only_nonheart_offtarget[doubly_unassigned] <-
      trimws(tolower(query_organ)) != tolower(heart_label) &
      query_organ_score >= cao_score_threshold
  }

  ## All other doubly-unassigned cells remain unresolved
  unresolved <- doubly_unassigned & !organ_only_nonheart_offtarget

  four_way_status <- rep(NA_character_, number_of_cells)

  four_way_status[adult_assigned] <-
    "Adult-heart assigned"

  four_way_status[fetal_recovered] <-
    "Fetal cardiac-compatible"

  four_way_status[organ_only_nonheart_offtarget] <-
    "Extra-cardiac assigned"

  four_way_status[unresolved] <-
    "Unresolved"

  ## Confirm that the four categories are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.
  membership_count <-
    as.integer(adult_assigned) +
    as.integer(fetal_recovered) +
    as.integer(organ_only_nonheart_offtarget) +
    as.integer(unresolved)

  if (any(membership_count != 1L) || anyNA(four_way_status)) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      ": the four-way classification is not mutually exclusive and exhaustive"
    )
  }

  ## Retain the established downstream field name so all existing plotting
  ## blocks use the newly selected organ-only definition consistently.
  object$cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget <-
    organ_only_nonheart_offtarget

  object$cao_organ_only_nonheart_offtarget <-
    organ_only_nonheart_offtarget

  object$cao_offtarget_definition <- ifelse(
    doubly_unassigned,
    "organ_nonheart_and_organ_score_ge_0.70",
    NA_character_
  )

  object$four_way_analysis_status <- factor(
    four_way_status,
    levels = four_way_levels
  )

  org_list[[dataset]] <- object
  rm(object, metadata)
}

```



```{r}
# ============================================================
## Visualization for Figure 4a
## Four-way composition of every organoid dataset:
##   1. Adult-heart assigned
##   2. Fetal cardiac-compatible
##   3. Extra-cardiac assigned
##   4. Unresolved
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
})

visualization_dir <- file.path(
  './offtarget_results',
  "visualizations"
)
dir.create(visualization_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Prepare plot data
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

four_way_counts <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(org_list), function(dataset) {
    status <- factor(
      org_list[[dataset]]$four_way_analysis_status,
      levels = four_way_levels
    )

    counts <- table(status)

    data.frame(
      dataset = dataset,
      category = four_way_levels,
      cells = as.integer(counts[four_way_levels]),
      total_cells = length(status),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

four_way_counts$proportion_percent <-
  100 * four_way_counts$cells / four_way_counts$total_cells

## Validate that all four categories reconstruct every complete dataset.
count_check <- aggregate(
  cells ~ dataset,
  data = four_way_counts,
  FUN = sum
)

expected_total_cells <- vapply(
  org_list,
  ncol,
  numeric(1)
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    count_check$cells ==
      expected_total_cells[count_check$dataset]
  )
)

proportion_check <- aggregate(
  proportion_percent ~ dataset,
  data = four_way_counts,
  FUN = sum
)

if (!all(abs(proportion_check$proportion_percent - 100) < 1e-8)) {
  stop("The four-category proportions do not sum to 100%")
}

four_way_counts$category <- factor(
  four_way_counts$category,
  levels = four_way_levels
)



## Order datasets by the combined proportion of Off-target (Extra-cardiac assigned) + Unresolved cells.
## The first ggplot y-axis factor level appears at the bottom, so reverse the
## desired top-to-bottom order when defining the levels.
offtarget_unresolved_order <- aggregate(
  proportion_percent ~ dataset,
  data = four_way_counts[
    as.character(four_way_counts$category) %in%
      c("Extra-cardiac assigned", "Unresolved"),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ],
  FUN = sum
)

colnames(offtarget_unresolved_order)[
  colnames(offtarget_unresolved_order) == "proportion_percent"
] <- "offtarget_plus_unresolved_percent"

offtarget_unresolved_order <- offtarget_unresolved_order[
  order(
    offtarget_unresolved_order$offtarget_plus_unresolved_percent,
    offtarget_unresolved_order$dataset
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

dataset_order_top_to_bottom <-
  offtarget_unresolved_order$dataset

four_way_counts$dataset <- factor(
  four_way_counts$dataset,
  levels = rev(dataset_order_top_to_bottom)
)


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Generate the figure and save as pdf file
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

four_way_colours <- c(
  "Adult-heart assigned" = "#4E79A7",
  "Fetal cardiac-compatible" = "#59A14F",
  "Extra-cardiac assigned" = "darkgray",
  "Unresolved" = "lightgray"
)

four_way_plot <- ggplot(
  four_way_counts,
  aes(
    x = proportion_percent,
    y = dataset,
    fill = category
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.78,
    colour = NA,
    linewidth = 0,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = four_way_colours,
    breaks = four_way_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  )  +
  labs(
    title = "Sequential classification of cardiac organoid cells",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Each dataset sums to 100%"
    ),
    x = "Cells in each dataset (%)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10.5,
      colour = "#555555",
      margin = margin(b = 10)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 11.5,
      margin = margin(t = 8)
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.margin = margin(b = 5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      colour = "#E5E5E5",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
  t = 10,
  r = 30,
  b = 10,
  l = 10,
  unit = "pt"
)
  )+
  scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
) +
coord_cartesian(
  xlim = c(0, 100),
  clip = "off"
)

four_way_pdf_path <- file.path(
  visualization_dir,
  "Figure4a_four_way_cell_classification_by_dataset.pdf"
)

grDevices::pdf(
  four_way_pdf_path,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  family = "Helvetica",
  useDingbats = FALSE,
  onefile = FALSE
)

print(four_way_plot)
grDevices::dev.off()

message("Saved editable PDF: ", four_way_pdf_path)

```






```{r}
# ============================================================================================
# Visualization for Supplementary Figure 4c
#
# Off-target tissue prevalence across datasets
# Each bar = number of datasets containing >=1 off-target cell predicted as that tissue
# ============================================================================================

required_columns <- c(
  "cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget",
  "cao_fetal_organ"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  unique(unlist(lapply(org_list, function(x) colnames(x@meta.data))))
)

if (length(missing_columns)) {
  stop(
    "Required metadata columns are missing: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Prepare plot data
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


offtarget_tissue_by_dataset <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(org_list), function(dataset) {
    metadata <- org_list[[dataset]]@meta.data

    keep <- !is.na(metadata$cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget) &
      metadata$cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget &
      !is.na(metadata$cao_fetal_organ) &
      nzchar(as.character(metadata$cao_fetal_organ))

    selected_tissues <- as.character(metadata$cao_fetal_organ[keep])

    data.frame(
      dataset = rep(dataset, length(selected_tissues)),
      tissue = selected_tissues,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

if (is.null(offtarget_tissue_by_dataset) ||
    nrow(offtarget_tissue_by_dataset) == 0) {
  stop("No confident non-heart off-target cells were found")
}

# Reduce to presence/absence: one row per dataset–tissue combination
offtarget_tissue_presence <- unique(offtarget_tissue_by_dataset)

total_datasets <- length(org_list)

offtarget_tissue_prevalence <- aggregate(
  dataset ~ tissue,
  data = offtarget_tissue_presence,
  FUN = function(x) length(unique(x))
)

colnames(offtarget_tissue_prevalence)[
  colnames(offtarget_tissue_prevalence) == "dataset"
] <- "datasets_with_tissue"

offtarget_tissue_prevalence$percentage_of_datasets <-
  100 * offtarget_tissue_prevalence$datasets_with_tissue / total_datasets

# Rank from most widespread to least widespread;
# alphabetical ordering is used to break ties
offtarget_tissue_prevalence <- offtarget_tissue_prevalence[
  order(
    -offtarget_tissue_prevalence$datasets_with_tissue,
    offtarget_tissue_prevalence$tissue
  ),
]

offtarget_tissue_prevalence$tissue <- factor(
  offtarget_tissue_prevalence$tissue,
  levels = offtarget_tissue_prevalence$tissue
)

## One named tissue palette is created once and reused by every tissue-level figure.
tissue_palette_levels <- sort(
  unique(as.character(offtarget_tissue_by_dataset$tissue))
)

master_tissue_colors <- tryCatch(
  {
    if (exists("scPalette", mode = "function")) {
      scPalette(length(tissue_palette_levels))
    } else if (requireNamespace("scCustomize", quietly = TRUE)) {
      scCustomize::scPalette(length(tissue_palette_levels))
    } else {
      stop("scPalette is unavailable")
    }
  },
  error = function(e) {
    scales::hue_pal()(length(tissue_palette_levels))
  }
)

master_tissue_colors <- master_tissue_colors[
  seq_along(tissue_palette_levels)
]
names(master_tissue_colors) <- tissue_palette_levels

print(offtarget_tissue_prevalence)


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Generate the figure and save as pdf file
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


p_offtarget_tissue_prevalence <- ggplot(
  offtarget_tissue_prevalence,
  aes(x = tissue, y = datasets_with_tissue,fill = tissue)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.72,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        datasets_with_tissue,
        " (",
        sprintf("%.1f", percentage_of_datasets),
        "%)"
      )
    ),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 4
  )+
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = master_tissue_colors,
    guide = "none",
    drop = FALSE
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, total_datasets),
    breaks = seq(0, total_datasets, by = 2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of off-target tissue identities across organoid datasets",
    x = "Predicted extra-cardiac tissue identity",
    y = "Number of datasets containing each tissue identity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 22, 12, 12)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    visualization_dir,
    "FigureS4c_offtarget_tissue_prevalence_across_datasets.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_offtarget_tissue_prevalence,
  width = max(9, 0.65 * nrow(offtarget_tissue_prevalence) + 3),
  height = 6.5,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```





```{r}
# ============================================================================================
# Visualization for Figure 4b
#
# Tissue prevalence–abundance summary and bubble plot 
# ============================================================================================


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Prepare plot data
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


offtarget_tissue_by_dataset <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(org_list), function(dataset) {
    metadata <- org_list[[dataset]]@meta.data

    keep <- !is.na(metadata$cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget) &
      metadata$cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget &
      !is.na(metadata$cao_fetal_organ) &
      nzchar(as.character(metadata$cao_fetal_organ))

    selected_tissues <- as.character(metadata$cao_fetal_organ[keep])

    data.frame(
      dataset = rep(dataset, length(selected_tissues)),
      tissue = selected_tissues,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)


dataset_sizes <- data.frame(
  dataset = names(org_list),
  total_dataset_cells = vapply(org_list, ncol, numeric(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Count cells for every observed dataset–tissue combination
tissue_cell_counts <- aggregate(
  x = list(offtarget_tissue_cells = rep(
    1L,
    nrow(offtarget_tissue_by_dataset)
  )),
  by = list(
    dataset = offtarget_tissue_by_dataset$dataset,
    tissue = offtarget_tissue_by_dataset$tissue
  ),
  FUN = sum
)

# Create all 22 dataset × tissue combinations so that absent tissues
# are explicitly represented by zero
all_tissues <- sort(unique(offtarget_tissue_by_dataset$tissue))

dataset_tissue_grid <- expand.grid(
  dataset = names(org_list),
  tissue = all_tissues,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dataset_tissue_abundance <- merge(
  dataset_tissue_grid,
  tissue_cell_counts,
  by = c("dataset", "tissue"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

dataset_tissue_abundance$offtarget_tissue_cells[
  is.na(dataset_tissue_abundance$offtarget_tissue_cells)
] <- 0L

dataset_tissue_abundance <- merge(
  dataset_tissue_abundance,
  dataset_sizes,
  by = "dataset",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

# Total confident off-target cells in each dataset
dataset_offtarget_totals <- aggregate(
  offtarget_tissue_cells ~ dataset,
  data = dataset_tissue_abundance,
  FUN = sum
)

colnames(dataset_offtarget_totals)[2] <- "total_offtarget_cells"

dataset_tissue_abundance <- merge(
  dataset_tissue_abundance,
  dataset_offtarget_totals,
  by = "dataset",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

dataset_tissue_abundance$percentage_of_all_cells <-
  100 *
  dataset_tissue_abundance$offtarget_tissue_cells /
  dataset_tissue_abundance$total_dataset_cells

dataset_tissue_abundance$percentage_within_offtarget <- ifelse(
  dataset_tissue_abundance$total_offtarget_cells > 0,
  100 *
    dataset_tissue_abundance$offtarget_tissue_cells /
    dataset_tissue_abundance$total_offtarget_cells,
  NA_real_
)

# Produce one summary row per tissue
tissue_summary_list <- lapply(
  all_tissues,
  function(current_tissue) {
    tissue_data <- dataset_tissue_abundance[
      dataset_tissue_abundance$tissue == current_tissue,
    ]

    positive <- tissue_data$offtarget_tissue_cells > 0

    data.frame(
      tissue = current_tissue,

      # Prevalence
      datasets_with_tissue = sum(positive),
      percentage_of_datasets =
        100 * sum(positive) / length(org_list),

      # Total cell count
      total_offtarget_cells = sum(
        tissue_data$offtarget_tissue_cells
      ),

      # Includes zero values from datasets where this tissue is absent
      median_percentage_all_cells_across_all_datasets =
        median(tissue_data$percentage_of_all_cells),

      # Abundance when the tissue is present
      median_percentage_all_cells_when_present =
        median(tissue_data$percentage_of_all_cells[positive]),

      median_percentage_within_offtarget_when_present =
        median(
          tissue_data$percentage_within_offtarget[positive],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      maximum_percentage_all_cells =
        max(tissue_data$percentage_of_all_cells),

      maximum_percentage_within_offtarget =
        max(
          tissue_data$percentage_within_offtarget,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
)

offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance <- do.call(
  rbind,
  tissue_summary_list
)

offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance <-
  offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance[
    order(
      -offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance$datasets_with_tissue,
      -offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance$
        median_percentage_all_cells_when_present,
      offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance$tissue
    ),
  ]

print(offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance)



## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Generate the figure and save as pdf file
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_data <- offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance

number_of_tissues <- nrow(plot_data)

## Reuse the master palette generated in the figS4c.
if (!exists("master_tissue_colors") ||
    !all(all_tissues %in% names(master_tissue_colors))) {
  master_tissue_colors <- tryCatch(
    {
      if (exists("scPalette", mode = "function")) {
        scPalette(length(all_tissues))
      } else if (requireNamespace("scCustomize", quietly = TRUE)) {
        scCustomize::scPalette(length(all_tissues))
      } else {
        stop("scPalette is unavailable")
      }
    },
    error = function(e) {
      scales::hue_pal()(length(all_tissues))
    }
  )

  master_tissue_colors <- master_tissue_colors[
    seq_along(all_tissues)
  ]
  names(master_tissue_colors) <- all_tissues
}


# Descriptive reference lines—not formal biological thresholds
prevalence_reference <- median(plot_data$datasets_with_tissue)

abundance_reference <- median(
  plot_data$median_percentage_within_offtarget_when_present
)

p_tissue_prevalence_abundance <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = datasets_with_tissue,
    y = median_percentage_within_offtarget_when_present,
    size = total_offtarget_cells,
    color = tissue
  )
)  +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.85,
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  aes(label = tissue),
  size = 3.5,
  show.legend = FALSE,
  max.overlaps = Inf,
  box.padding = 0.5,
  point.padding = 0.35,
  min.segment.length = 0,
  segment.color = "grey55",
  segment.linewidth = 0.3,
  seed = 1
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = master_tissue_colors,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(4, 15),
    name = "Total cell assigned\nto tissue type"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, length(org_list), by = 2),
    limits = c(0, length(org_list)),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(
      format(round(x, 3), trim = TRUE),
      "%"
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence and abundance of off-target tissue identities",
    x = "Number of datasets with cells assigned to each tissue type",
    y = "Median proportion of extra-cardiac assigned \ncells in datasets containing each tissue type (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(15, 45, 15, 15)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    visualization_dir,
    "Figure4b_offtarget_tissue_prevalence_abundance_bubble.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_tissue_prevalence_abundance,
  width = 11,
  height = 7.5,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```




```{r}

# ============================================================================================
# Visualization for Supplementary Figure 4b
#
## Each bar represents one dataset. The denominator is the number of cells in
## that dataset satisfying the selected organ-only off-target definition
## Non-empty bars sum to 100%.
# ============================================================================================


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Prepare plot data
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


required_offtarget_tissue_fields <- c(
  "cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget",
  "cao_fetal_organ"
)

for (dataset in names(org_list)) {
  missing_fields <- setdiff(
    required_offtarget_tissue_fields,
    colnames(org_list[[dataset]]@meta.data)
  )

  if (length(missing_fields)) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      ": missing fields required for off-target tissue composition: ",
      paste(missing_fields, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
}

offtarget_tissue_composition_cells <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(org_list), function(dataset) {
    metadata <- org_list[[dataset]]@meta.data

    off_target <-
      metadata$cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget %in% TRUE

    predicted_tissue <- as.character(
      metadata$cao_fetal_organ
    )

    if (any(
      off_target &
        (is.na(predicted_tissue) | !nzchar(predicted_tissue))
    )) {
      stop(
        dataset,
        ": an organ-only off-target cell lacks a predicted tissue"
      )
    }

    data.frame(
      dataset = rep(dataset, sum(off_target)),
      tissue = predicted_tissue[off_target],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

if (is.null(offtarget_tissue_composition_cells) ||
    nrow(offtarget_tissue_composition_cells) == 0L) {
  stop("No organ-only off-target cells were available for composition plotting")
}


composition_tissues <- sort(unique(
  offtarget_tissue_composition_cells$tissue
))

## Reuse the master palette generated in the figS4c.
if (!exists("master_tissue_colors") ||
    !all(composition_tissues %in% names(master_tissue_colors))) {
  master_tissue_colors <- tryCatch(
    {
      if (exists("scPalette", mode = "function")) {
        scPalette(length(composition_tissues))
      } else if (requireNamespace("scCustomize", quietly = TRUE)) {
        scCustomize::scPalette(length(composition_tissues))
      } else {
        stop("scPalette is unavailable")
      }
    },
    error = function(e) {
      scales::hue_pal()(length(composition_tissues))
    }
  )

  master_tissue_colors <- master_tissue_colors[
    seq_along(composition_tissues)
  ]
  names(master_tissue_colors) <- composition_tissues
}

## Count every dataset-tissue combination, explicitly retaining zeros.
offtarget_tissue_count_observed <- aggregate(
  x = list(cells = rep(
    1L,
    nrow(offtarget_tissue_composition_cells)
  )),
  by = list(
    dataset = offtarget_tissue_composition_cells$dataset,
    tissue = offtarget_tissue_composition_cells$tissue
  ),
  FUN = sum
)

offtarget_tissue_composition <- merge(
  expand.grid(
    dataset = names(org_list),
    tissue = composition_tissues,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  offtarget_tissue_count_observed,
  by = c("dataset", "tissue"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

offtarget_tissue_composition$cells[
  is.na(offtarget_tissue_composition$cells)
] <- 0L

offtarget_totals <- aggregate(
  cells ~ dataset,
  data = offtarget_tissue_composition,
  FUN = sum
)
colnames(offtarget_totals)[2] <- "total_offtarget_cells"

offtarget_tissue_composition <- merge(
  offtarget_tissue_composition,
  offtarget_totals,
  by = "dataset",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

offtarget_tissue_composition$proportion_percent <- ifelse(
  offtarget_tissue_composition$total_offtarget_cells > 0,
  100 *
    offtarget_tissue_composition$cells /
    offtarget_tissue_composition$total_offtarget_cells,
  0
)

## Verify the plotted denominator against the Seurat metadata.
expected_offtarget_totals <- vapply(
  org_list,
  function(object) {
    sum(object$cao_confident_nonheart_offtarget %in% TRUE)
  },
  numeric(1)
)

observed_offtarget_totals <- setNames(
  offtarget_totals$total_offtarget_cells,
  offtarget_totals$dataset
)

if (!all(
  observed_offtarget_totals[names(org_list)] ==
    expected_offtarget_totals[names(org_list)]
)) {
  stop("Off-target tissue-composition denominators failed validation")
}

composition_sum_check <- aggregate(
  proportion_percent ~ dataset,
  data = offtarget_tissue_composition,
  FUN = sum
)

nonempty_datasets <- observed_offtarget_totals[
  composition_sum_check$dataset
] > 0

if (any(
  abs(
    composition_sum_check$proportion_percent[nonempty_datasets] -
      100
  ) > 1e-8
)) {
  stop("A non-empty off-target tissue-composition bar does not sum to 100%")
}

dataset_composition_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(
    names(org_list),
    " (n=",
    format(
      expected_offtarget_totals[names(org_list)],
      big.mark = ","
    ),
    ")"
  ),
  names(org_list)
)

## Reuse the exact dataset order from Figure 4a
shared_dataset_levels <- levels(
  four_way_counts$dataset
)

if (is.null(shared_dataset_levels)) {
  stop(
    "four_way_counts$dataset is not an ordered factor. ",
    "Run the four-way ordering block first."
  )
}

if (!setequal(
  unique(as.character(
    offtarget_tissue_composition$dataset
  )),
  shared_dataset_levels
)) {
  stop(
    "The tissue-composition datasets do not match ",
    "the four-way plot datasets"
  )
}

offtarget_tissue_composition$dataset <- factor(
  as.character(offtarget_tissue_composition$dataset),
  levels = shared_dataset_levels
)

offtarget_tissue_composition$tissue <- factor(
  offtarget_tissue_composition$tissue,
  levels = composition_tissues
)


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Generate the figure and save as pdf file
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


p_offtarget_tissue_composition <- ggplot(
  offtarget_tissue_composition,
  aes(
    x = proportion_percent,
    y = dataset,
    fill = tissue
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.78,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.16,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = master_tissue_colors,
    breaks = composition_tissues,
    drop = FALSE
  ) + scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0, 100),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = dataset_composition_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted tissue composition of organ-only off-target cells",
    x = "Proportion of extra-cardiac assigned cells (%)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Extra-cardiac assigned"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10.5,
      colour = "#555555",
      margin = margin(b = 10)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11.5, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.75, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      colour = "#E5E5E5",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 35, 12, 12)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    visualization_dir,
    "FigureS4b_offtarget_predicted_tissue_composition_by_dataset.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_offtarget_tissue_composition,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

print(offtarget_tissue_composition, row.names = FALSE)
```
